entries.en: so it is; it is indeed so
it is exactly so; truly so
yes, yes; quite so

entries.zh: 正是这样；就是这么回事
entries.en: it is just so, as I say
entries.notes: L 末 ':hicha' 疑为随句所记闽南语缀词，未能考定，不影响主句义

entries.en: how lucky; by coincidence
entries.notes: L 'asi cada mi raudate' 残破难读，释义据 R 栏'可巧'及 H'巧'定夺

entries.zh: 真美；观看之下令人赞叹
entries.en: they are beautiful, a sight to admire
entries.notes: H 三字'嚇親淺'与 R'可欽羨'仅部分相应，取 L 'hermoso/admirando' 的美叹义

entries.zh: 实在令人钦佩；确实可敬可亲
entries.en: truly admirable; worthy of admiration
entries.notes: R'可親'可作 amiable 解，此处从 L 'admirándote' 取钦佩义

entries.en: so it is possible; astonishing
entries.notes: L 'esposi'ble'（=posible）与 H/R'生年/可生羨'不相接，四栏不能互证，姑存大意

entries.zh: 我因此受了重伤；落得这般苦况
entries.en: and so I was left badly hurt
entries.notes: H/R'話向多'与 L 义不相接，疑原刻此处栏位错行，释义以 L 为主

entries.en: thus stands the sick man; such is the patient's state
entries.notes: H 首字'卯'疑为'那/若'之讹，R 首音 nā 与 L 'así' 相合

entries.zh: 如此，又这般强壮、这般大
entries.en: and so strong, and so great
entries.notes: L 'yque destra fuerte yso grande' 残破，H/R'那拙大'仅'大'义可据，余为推断

entries.en: so, and not of this strength
entries.notes: L 句意残缺，H'那只年'与'fuerte'无对应，未敢定夺

entries.en: seat; the bottom or base of a clay vessel
entries.notes: L 'baxija' 即 vajilla（瓦器），与 H'底'、R'tÿ' 相合；M 栏'sÿ hey'残乱

entries.en: the lees of wine; wine dregs
entries.notes: H 次字残（疑'糟'），R'chō'与'糟'相应，L 作 asiento del vino 即酒滓

entries.en: drum stand; the frame of a drum
to reside; to dwell
entries.notes: L 'A sittir''hamitar' 即 asistir、habitar；尾'minim'未详

entries.en: to reside in some place
to dwell; to stay
entries.notes: L 末词'#orat'残损（疑 orar/oratorio），释义依 H/R'居'

entries.en: to dwell; to inhabit
to reside in a place; a dwelling place
to dwell in a house; to reside
entries.notes: M 栏'quea viayr'失序难读，H'住厝'与 L 相合

entries.en: to dwell in a house
entries.notes: L 'caja'疑为'casa'（屋宅）之讹；H 次字残，R 指向'住處'

entries.en: asthma; cough
entries.notes: L 'A srma'当为 asma（哮喘），与 H'咳'相应；M 栏污损
